short_description: Ceasefire 4 kg ABC MAP 90 stored-pressure extinguisher. 4A 144B rating, 15 bar working pressure, IS 15683 and EN 3 certified.
long_description:
## What it is

The Ceasefire ABC Powder MAP 90 4 kg (product code CF-001144) is a stored-pressure portable fire extinguisher charged with 90% mono ammonium phosphate dry chemical powder. The shell is a two-piece welded deep-drawn steel cylinder, 140 mm across and 445 mm tall, finished in epoxy-polyester powder coating and fitted with a forged brass squeeze-grip valve, a pressure gauge and a discharge hose. Charged, the unit weighs about 6.5 kg.

## What it's for

One extinguisher covers Class A (wood, paper, textiles), Class B (flammable liquids), Class C (flammable gases) and electrically started fires, so the user does not have to identify the fire class before acting. That makes it the default first-aid appliance for homes, apartments, offices, shops and showrooms, godowns, workshops, electrical panel rooms and cars — roughly 55 m² of protected floor area per unit.

## Key specifications

It carries a 4A 144B rating under IS 15683 and 21A 144B under EN 3, works at 15 bar and is hydraulically tested at 35 bar. Rated service range is −30 °C to 60 °C, so it stays usable in an unventilated Telangana warehouse in May. Throw range is over 2 m and the charge empties in roughly 15 seconds of continuous discharge. Beyond the BIS certification to IS 15683, this range is dual-certified to EN 3 and PED and carries LPCB approval, the BSI Kitemark and CE marking. The manufacturer warranty runs 120 months.

## Application and installation notes

Follow IS 2190 for siting: mount on the supplied wall bracket with the carrying handle about 1 m above finished floor, on an escape route and clear of the hazard it protects. Keep the safety pin sealed until use. Inspect the gauge monthly — the needle must sit in the green band — and have the unit inspected every 12 months. Hydraulic re-testing is due every 3 years, and the extinguisher must be refilled after any discharge, however brief. Powder residue is non-conductive but fine, and needs vacuuming and wiping afterwards.

## What's in the box

One charged 4 kg extinguisher with hose and pressure gauge, a wall-mounting bracket, a sealed safety pin and the instruction manual, in a single corrugated carton.
